title: Osmium(VIII)-catalyzed oxidative degradation of paracetamol by chloramine-T in an aqueous alkaline medium: computational screening and mechanistic pathways
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32609-32617
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03805G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Deepmala Pareek, Asha Rolaniya, Akta Yadav, Nikita, Menka Bhasin, Anita Meena, Mamta Ranka, Priyanka Jain, Riya Sailani
The reaction of paracetamol with chloramine-T in the presence of a transition metal catalyst reveals mechanistic pathways and rate dependencies, while oxidant speciation and Os(VIII) reactivity in alkaline medium can be modeled mathematically.
